encodings.note: Returns processor identification and feature information to the EAX, EBX, ECX, and EDX registers, as determined by input entered in EAX and, in some cases, ECX.

exceptions.when: If the LOCK prefix is used. 1. On Intel 64 processors, CPUID clears the high 32 bits of the RAX/RBX/RCX/RDX registers in all modes. In earlier IA-32 processors that do not support the CPUID instruction, execution of the instruction results in an invalid opcode (#UD) exception being generated.
